description: A drawing of the library gains a `<TEXT>` written in capitals, and 1.4.5 keeps resting on the scan. Angular draws it as written, no text element in the browser; its server renderer writes `<TEXT>` into the page, and the browser's HTML parser lowers it to a `<text>`, drawn, which hydration keeps (Chromium 153, Firefox 155, WebKit 26.6, the page from Angular 22.2's `renderApplication`, 2026-10-19). Read as written, the scan found none.
